name: Steinheim (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided green over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Steinheim (a red city wall with towers on white).
history: The arms were granted on 11 November 1972 by the Regierungspräsident in Detmold, confirming the traditional arms already granted by the Prussian king on 23 March 1908.

features.role: Steinheim arms — red city wall with towers on white
